paragraphs: Rava bar Ihi spoke to Rav Idi bar Avin: Bava Metzia 14a, bar Ittai; so too Shevuot 34b, bar Ittai, and there, 37a. With Rav Aha bar Huna, Rav Shmuel son of רבב״ח [provisionally Rabbah bar bar Hana], Rav Yitzhak bar Rav Yehudah, Rav Kahana, and Rabbah. Yet Keritot 24a has ‘Rabbah bar Ittai said that Resh Lakish said.’ See below, Rabbah bar Ahita to Resh Lakish, end of Bekhorot; so Yuhasin brings it. Perhaps they are one.
